$comment: The design-review-approved packs: the single source of truth for which packs ship to customers. Consumed by scripts/build-templates-artifact.sh (the CI-published composed-template artifact), and by the platform repo's template staging, publish, and image scripts (they read this file from the kernel checkout instead of carrying their own lists). The platform's TemplateRegistry APPROVED_TEMPLATE_KEYS is the product-side mirror — keep them in step. Approving a pack is adding its key here (plus the registry mirror); the other packs stay in the repo untouched.
